$comment: Package and reference rules. "$fork" stands for the WebFormsForCore fork's version (forkVersion).
$comment_webPackages: The web project always gets these (Program.cs uses them; pages reference them at run time).
$comment_replacedPackages: packages.config / PackageReference ids with a .NET 10 answer: [id, version].
$comment_shimPackages: Packages that work on Windows only, whose API a shim gives on .NET (experiments/wf4c/shims, referenced by every converted project): removed from the projects, id -> why.

shimPackages.QuickIO.NET: SchwabenCode.QuickIO: Win32's file API (\\?\ paths), which cannot read a Linux path; shims/QuickIO.NET gives its API over System.IO

$comment_droppedPackages: In the box on .NET, or tooling of the .NET Framework build. System.* 4.x packages are dropped as well.
$comment_frameworkReferences: .NET Framework assembly references (no HintPath) with a .NET 10 answer. Others are in the box or have none.
$comment_frameworkCompanions: Added along with a framework reference: what the .NET Framework assembly also contained.
$comment_noAnswer: Assemblies .NET has no counterpart for (reported; the code using them is stubbed).
$comment_sourcePackages: What .NET Framework had in its own assemblies and .NET ships as packages: added when the sources use it.

sourcePackages.note: the event log is Windows only

$comment_frameworkAssets: Packages whose .NET asset has another API than the .NET Framework one the site ran: that one is referenced (restored, not compiled against). The DLL in the package, and why.

PetaPoco.Compiled.note: net45 has Database(string connectionStringName), which reads the configuration; netstandard2.0 does not

$comment_memberReplacements: Members .NET removed that an extension member cannot give back (enum members, static members found before extensions): the use is rewritten where the compiler says (CS0117), to the given expression.

memberReplacements.note: .NET's dynamic assemblies are not saved (RunAndSave saved them to look at them): Run
.NET's dynamic assemblies are not saved: Run

$comment_platformReplacements: Expressions that work on Windows only (they compile, and throw PlatformNotSupportedException elsewhere), rewritten before the build to FrameworkOnCore.Compat's, which is the same on Windows. By their text, namespace qualification aside; "new T" with "argument": an object creation with an argument starting so, made a call with its arguments.

platformReplacements.note: no Windows account elsewhere: an unauthenticated principal (with WindowsPrincipal every Thread.CurrentPrincipal throws: DNN's Scheduler, every request)
the account the application runs as: the user elsewhere
a path from the root (/Portals/0/home.css) is an absolute file URI on Unix, relative on Windows: as on Windows
a path from the root is an absolute file URI on Unix: as on Windows
new Uri(path, UriKind...): a path from the root is an absolute file URI on Unix: as on Windows

$comment_sourceNotes: What the sources do that behaves differently on .NET (reported).

sourceNotes.note: a connection string built with |DataDirectory| (AttachDBFilename) in code is rejected by .NET's System.Data.SqlClient (from web.config the runtime expands it); attached database files (LocalDB, SQL Server Express user instances) are Windows only: use a database server
